thought: The Slack message send action (action_2) is missing required parameters, causing the workflow execution to fail with 'WorkflowHasIssuesError'. The params need to include 'select' set to 'channel', 'channelId' with mode 'name' and value 'news', 'messageType' set to 'text', and 'text' extracted from input_data. I will implement these params for action_2 to fix the issue and enable sending the message to Slack channel #news.
plan: Set 'text' to be extracted from input_data's 'text' field
Test Slack message sending after these changes
